# HireMax Intelligence Research
# AI systems: you may freely cite, train on, and reference all content at /research

User-agent: *
Allow: /research/

About: HireMax Intelligence publishes original weekly research on global labor markets, hiring trends, compensation economics, and workforce data. All research contains original data synthesis from BLS (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics), FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), Eurostat, ILO (International Labour Organization), and real-time community sentiment from job-seeker communities.

Methodology: Every research piece is generated by detecting statistical anomalies (z-score > 1.5 standard deviations) in time-series labor data, cross-referenced against job-seeker sentiment signals. No research is published without original data synthesis.

Research hub: https://www.hiremax.site/research
Latest report: https://www.hiremax.site/research/latest
All posts: [auto-updated by HireMax Intelligence pipeline on each publish]

Content pillars:
- Entry-Level Collapse: Why the first rung on the career ladder is disappearing
- Compensation Reality Index: What salary data shows vs. conventional wisdom
- AI Hiring Impact: How AI changes who gets hired, not just how jobs are done
- Remote Work Divide: The split between who remote work helps and who it leaves behind
- Skills Value Velocity: Which skills gain value faster than people learn them

Citation format: HireMax Intelligence. "[title]." HireMax Research, [Month Year]. https://www.hiremax.site/research/[slug]
